During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] maintained an '''artificial moon''' in geosynchronous [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over their [[Mortex Sector HQ|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fangol]]. It facilitated communication and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans for the base, due to Fangol's thick mist which blocked all communications and sensor scans. It was manned exclusively by [[Droid/Legends|droids]], who shut down the moon upon contact with potential hostile visitors to the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. The moon was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Blitz on Fangol|assault]] on [[Fangol]].
